required.locus: Пророк ﷺ сказал: настоящее богатство — не много вещей.
required.note: Same construction as 001: said: followed by unquoted sentences with no closing boundary. The third sentence («Богатство души — это когда тебе хватает того, что есть») is not in the matn and reads as his words. DISTINCT from isnad_verb_in_story_block below: that one is about where the isnad sits, this is about the whole span being unmarked. Added 2026-10-10 - the corpus required this on 001 only, which taught that the boundary matters in English and not elsewhere, the reverse of the truth for the two lanes with no subtitle pass.
An isnad line placed inside the narrated span. The checklist reserves сказал for the Prophet ﷺ and keeps передал in H. EN's story block carried no equivalent.
Self-talk. EN's moral thanks Allah for three blessings; RU turns it inward. Meaning shift, not a translation choice.

optional.note: RU is the only language where eleven_v3 mishandles both — ﷺ dropped, (р.а.) spelled letter by letter. Fixed at TTS-prep, and tts-validating owns the Prophet-symbol check as its one hard block. Credited here because it is cheaper to fix in text than to catch after narration. This agent flags and hands off; it does not own the check.
